confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of local price levels, brought forward to July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation is least certain because hotel and hostel rates swing with season and demand. Cocktail and wine come from direct knowledge of bar and restaurant prices, cross-checked against the local beer relationship. The local currency is pegged to the US dollar, so FX risk is low. The FX observation is from RBA exchange-rate page summaries returned by search (the page itself was not opened): the same-day 15 October 2026 reading, with its 4pm posting time unconfirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Anchors are estimated from local price levels for casual and mid-range dining, bars, guesthouses and three-star hotels, placed within the East Asia regional basis.
